I will not be denied the glory of this kill!|audio=KonstantineGlory-ZeroHour.flac|Kassius Konstantine and the officer|}} An '''Imperial officer''' served aboard [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor]] during the [[Battle of Atollon]]. During the battle, the [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser's]] [[commanding officer]], [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]], ordered the [[Imperial officer|officer]] to move the [[Star Destroyer]] to intercept a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[command ship]], the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] ''[[Phoenix Nest]]''. Although the [[officer]] reminded Konstantine that their superior, [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]], had ordered them to maintain their position, Konstantine overruled his subordinate, citing that he''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' would not be denied the glory of the kill. The officer later informed Konstantine that the enemy [[Starship|vessel]] had changed course. Konstantine ordered them to take evasive action, but in moments the [[Interdictor]] had been destroyed by the [[ramming]] rebel ship. ==Behind the scenes== The officer appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Zero Hour]]," the finale of the series' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]]. The episode was released on [[March 25]], [[2017]] over two parts, the twenty-first and twenty-second episodes of the season overall.{{InsiderCite|174|Star Wars Rebels Season Three Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three Episode Guide}} In the episode, the officer was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]] and credited as "Imperial Officer." ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Seventh Fleet personnel]]
